📜 Community Guidelines

PikiHub is a community for sharing videos, music and creativity. These rules keep it fun and safe for everyone. Violations may result in warnings, content removal, or account bans — depending on severity and repeat offenses.

1. Respect others

No harassment, hate speech, threats, or bullying. Be kind — everyone here started somewhere.

2. No illegal or harmful content

Don't post content that is illegal, dangerous, or promotes harm. This includes exploits of other people's accounts and malware.

3. Respect copyright

Only upload content you have the right to share. Report content that infringes your rights and we will review it.

4. No spam or abuse

Don't flood uploads, comments, or messages, and don't manipulate views or likes. Quality over quantity.

5. Reports & moderation

Use the 🚩 Report button on any video, comment, or profile. Reports are reviewed by our moderation team. False reporting may itself be punished.

Guidelines last updated with PikiHub. Questions? Contact the site owner.

Upload Media

Notice: Video files over 20MB will be automatically compressed in your browser until they're 20MB or under before uploading (30MB for Legacy members). MP3/audio files have a hard 5MB limit and thumbnails have a hard 4MB limit (neither is auto-compressed). Because of Supabase's 500MB database and 1GB file storage limits (5GB cached egress), if content isn't popular we will delete it. Don't use this as a backup cloud.

NOTICE 2: SINCE YOU ARE A LEGACY ACCOUNT, YOU MAY UPLOAD 30MB (YOU ARE BLESSED). YOU LUCKY BASTARD. 🎉

⚠️ Only embed URLs from trusted sites. Do NOT paste unknown or suspicious URLs.

📊 Platform Stats

⚡ Flash Projects

ALLOW FLASH PROJECTS

When enabled, users can upload .swf Flash files. OFF by default.

🖼️ Iframe Embeds

ALLOW IFRAMES

When enabled, users can post iframe embeds via upload. OFF by default.

📄 Office Files

ALLOW OFFICE FILES

When enabled, users can upload .doc/.docx/.xls/.xlsx/.ppt/.pptx files. OFF by default.

🎵 Music Albums

ALLOW MUSIC ALBUM UPLOADS

When enabled, users can upload music albums with multiple tracks and the custom orange player. ON by default.

📁 PostFile CDN (Server 2)

POSTFILE UPLOADS

When enabled, users can choose "PostFile CDN" as an upload destination. 50MB limit per file. OFF by default.

MAKE POSTFILE DEFAULT

When enabled, "PostFile CDN" is pre-selected as the upload destination instead of "Website".

🚫 Supabase Storage

DISABLE SUPABASE UPLOADS

When ON, Website uploads to Supabase are blocked. Users must use PostFile CDN instead. Requires PostFile to be enabled.

♿ Old-Device Compatibility

ALLOW "CONTINUE ANYWAY" ON THE BROWSER-TOO-OLD SCREEN

When ON (default), devices that fail browser checks can press "Continue Anyway" and enter the site in a light compatibility mode (aimed at Android 4.x). When OFF, devices older than Android 4 or iOS 11 are blocked from continuing.
